assertion: Clicking the 'Generate' button initiates the AI generation process and shows a progress indicator.

evidence.observation: AI_OT_Generate operator is properly registered with bl_idname 'ai.generate'
evidence.detail: Operator class has proper Blender operator registration with REGISTER and UNDO options

evidence.observation: Poll method validates prompt length (1-1000 chars)
evidence.detail: poll() returns True only when prompt exists and length <= 1000, preventing invalid button activation

evidence.observation: Operator sets scene.ai_is_generating = True during execution
evidence.detail: Line sets 'scene.ai_is_generating = True' before any processing begins

evidence.observation: Status is updated to 'Generating...' during processing
evidence.detail: Line sets 'scene.ai_status = "Generating..."' to show progress state

evidence.observation: Progress indicator is displayed via panel's draw method checking ai_is_generating
evidence.detail: Panel shows 'Generating...' with TIME icon when scene.ai_is_generating is True

evidence.observation: Generation completes and status is updated to completion message
evidence.detail: After script generation, status updates to 'Generation complete. Review and execute the script.' and ai_is_generating is set to False

evidence.observation: Script is stored in preview and added to history
evidence.detail: Placeholder script is generated and stored in ai_current_script, then added to history with timestamp

evidence.observation: User report is generated to confirm completion
evidence.detail: self.report({'INFO'}, 'Script generated. Review and click Execute.') provides UI feedback

findings.summary: VAL-UI-003 is fully implemented. The Generate button (AI_OT_Generate operator) correctly initiates the generation process by:
details: 1. Validating prompt input before execution (poll method)
2. Setting ai_is_generating = True to trigger progress display
4. Displaying progress indicator in UI (panel shows TIME icon)
5. Completing workflow and updating status on finish
6. Providing visual feedback through Blender's report system

notes: The m1-foundation milestone uses a placeholder/stub implementation that generates a sample cube script without calling the actual API.
This is expected behavior for m1-foundation. The assertion validates that the button triggers the generation workflow, shows progress, and completes - which it does.
Actual API integration is planned for m2-api milestone (see api-client feature).
